[quote=indonocaismnic;59260156]Me to[/quote]

Erm atchually, saying "Me to." Isn't correct. The word "to" is a homophone of both "too" and "two". "To" is used in location, or used as a verb. "Too" is used as either a word for also (like at the same time) or an excess amount of something. "Two" is just the English spelling of the Aramaic number "2". In this sentence, you would use the homophome "too" because it means also, and you are also doing something. So the correct sentence would be "Me too."
